allhands-bot: Posting the follow-up thread for today's all-hands Q&A on product timelines (API streaming, Console rollout, Optimize beta). Keep questions short and we'll reply here.
Sam (Product): TL;DR: streaming GA aiming late June, Console feature-flag gradual rollout mid-Aug, Optimize public beta in Sep. We'll confirm exact calendar next Wednesday.
Ava (Sales): Are those dates firm enough to tell enterprise customers who asked for timelines?
Sam (Product): Not firm yet — next Wed we'll lock dates. For committed sales, we can offer early previews.
Ravi (Eng): Quick technical note: streaming GA gated on runtime v2.1 and the KV cache hotfix. v2.1 RC is in testing; hotfix target end of week.
Theo (SRE): Any risk of regional rollout delays due to infra changes? We should flag region-dependent customers.
Matt (DevEx): We plan to release SDK patch the same day as GA — minimal API surface change: `client.generate({stream: true})` plus a small callback handler. Migration doc will be ready pre-GA.
Lina (Design): Console change is a progressive opt-in toggle in settings. I need confirmation on which pages to show new nav; PMs, please confirm by July 3 so I can hand off assets.
Sam (Product): Confirmed — PMs, handoff July 3. Also: audit log support is not in the mid-Aug Console rollout; it's an add-on planned for late Q3.
Ava (Sales): Noted. We'll tell customers audit logs are coming Q3 and offer previews to enterprise pilots.
Jo (CEO): Prioritization rule: if Optimize beta leads to >5% latency regression or >10% error increase on our internal evals, hold the beta. We need clear perf guardrails.
Ravi (Eng): Understood. We'll run the perf matrix for quantization and batching changes and post results in this thread by next Tue.
Matt (DevEx): Also will add a code sample for the streaming callback and small snippet for graceful fallback to non-streaming responses.
Sam (Product): Action items: 1) Publish firm dates next Wed (Sam). 2) Lina to share Console mocks by July 3. 3) Ravi to post perf matrix by next Tue. 4) Matt to draft SDK migration guide pre-GA. 5) Theo to list region risk customers.
Ava (Sales): Can we get a one-paragraph FAQ about streaming guarantees, fallbacks, and SLA language to share with customers?
Sam (Product): I'll draft FAQ and loop Marketing.
allhands-bot: Thanks everyone — thread will be updated as items resolve. If you asked live and didn't hear back, please drop a follow-up here and tag @Sam (Product) or @Ravi (Eng). :thumbsup:
